title: From Intent to Improvement: Agentic Dataset Search for Better Model Training
title_zh: 从意图到改进：智能体数据集搜索助力更好的模型训练

paragraphs.en: Finding training data in million-scale machine learning repositories is a Web search problem where text relevance is not enough. A query couples a semantic training goal with constraints such as task, license, and training stage, and the metadata that would verify them are often missing. Text retrieval ranks dataset cards by similarity but cannot enforce hard constraints or follow the relations that reach a sparsely described dataset. Free-form tool-calling agents are more flexible, but the same model that picks a dataset also declares it a match, and nothing checks that the query’s constraints are actually met. Neither approach establishes that the data it returns will improve model training. To address it, we propose AgenticDS, a contract-governed agentic framework in which every language model decision instantiates a typed object before deterministic code consumes it. The framework compiles a query into a typed search plan, executes it through admissible deterministic operators over hybrid retrieval and bounded graph expansion, and verifies the provenance-grounded evidence before accepting a ranking or emitting a typed diagnosis that permits only local repairs. On HuDS-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 queries with 24,908 graded judgments pooled over 15 systems, AgenticDS improves NDCG@10 by 25.7% over the strongest dense–sparse hybrid and by 18.9% over a commercial LLM agent. A controlled search-to-train study further shows that the datasets it retrieves give the best downstream accuracy in mathematics, code, and medicine. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/nju-websoft/AgenticDS .
paragraphs.zh: 在百万级规模的机器学习仓库中寻找训练数据是一个网络搜索问题，仅靠文本相关性是不够的。 一个查询将语义层面的训练目标与诸如任务、许可证和训练阶段等约束耦合在一起，而能够验证这些约束的元数据往往是缺失的。 文本检索按相似度对数据集卡片进行排序，但无法强制执行硬性约束，也无法沿着那些能够到达描述稀疏的数据集的关系进行追踪。 自由形式的工具调用智能体更为灵活，但选择数据集的同一个模型也会宣称该数据集匹配，而没有任何机制检查查询的约束是否真正得到满足。 这两种方法都无法确认其返回的数据能够改进模型训练。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 AgenticDS，一个由契约治理的智能体框架，其中每个语言模型决策都先实例化为一个类型化对象，再由确定性代码消费。 该框架将查询编译为类型化的搜索计划，通过混合检索与有界图扩展上的可容许确定性算子执行该计划，并在接受排序或发出仅允许局部修复的类型化诊断之前，验证基于来源的证据。 在 HuDS-Bench（一个包含 200 个查询、汇聚 15 个系统、共 24,908 条分级判断的新基准）上，AgenticDS 将 NDCG@10 相比最强的稠密—稀疏混合方法提升了 25.7%，相比商业大语言模型智能体提升了 18.9%。 一项受控的搜索到训练研究进一步表明，它检索到的数据集在数学、代码和医学领域带来了最佳的下游准确率。 代码和数据已在 https://github.com/nju-websoft/AgenticDS 公开提供。

paragraphs.en: Open machine learning (ML) platforms, exemplified by Hugging Face, 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/ now host millions of interconnected datasets, models, papers, and curated collections. For a researcher who wants to improve a model, dataset acquisition is already a Web search problem: an underspecified training need must be turned into search operations over inconsistent metadata, relations across heterogeneous resources resolved, and candidates judged by whether they will change the behavior of the model being trained ( Chapman et al., 2020 ; Benjelloun et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Brickley et al., 2019 ) . Keyword and embedding-based retrieval help when dataset cards are complete, but they fail on hard structured constraints and ignore evidence implicit in training provenance, task tags, paper citations, or community collections ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024d ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 以 Hugging Face（1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/）为代表的开源机器学习（ML）平台如今承载了数百万个相互关联的数据集、模型、论文和精选合集。 对于想要改进模型的研究者来说，数据集获取本身已经是一个网络搜索问题：必须将一个欠明确的训练需求转化为在不一致元数据上的检索操作，解决异构资源之间的关系，并根据候选数据集是否会改变被训练模型的行为来加以评判（Chapman et al., 2020；Benjelloun et al., 2020；Li et al., 2025a；Brickley et al., 2019）。 当数据集卡片完备时，关键词检索和基于嵌入的检索能起到帮助作用，但它们在处理严格的结构化约束时会失败，并且忽略了隐含在训练溯源、任务标签、论文引用或社区合集中的证据（Chen et al., 2024b；Chen et al., 2024d；Zhou et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025；Lin et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Natural language dataset acquisition poses three coupled technical challenges . (1) A query mixes a semantic training goal with typed constraints such as task, modality, license, and training stage. Existing dataset search systems either flatten the query into one embedding ( Chen et al., 2023a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) or treat metadata fields independently ( Brickley et al., 2019 ; Chen et al., 2023b ) , so constraint violations stay invisible . Handing the tools to an LLM restores flexibility but adds no verification, so the same model that selects a dataset also declares it a match ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . (2) Evidence is heterogeneous. Text retrieval is precise when dataset cards are well written ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , while knowledge graph (KG) relations recover resources whose descriptions are sparse ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) . Structural connectivity does not imply semantic fit, however, so a naively added graph channel can hurt relevance when nothing suppresses the noise it introduces ( Luo et al., 2023 ) . (3) Retrieval relevance does not entail training utility. Standard benchmarks score ranking against graded relevance judgments ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2024c ) but never measure whether the selected data improve a downstream model , so linking search quality to data-centric recursive self-improvement (RSI), the loop in which evaluation results drive changes to the training data ( Zou et al., 2026 ) , requires a protocol that measures that change directly.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言数据集获取面临三个相互耦合的技术挑战。 (1) 一个查询同时混合了语义训练目标与类型化约束，例如任务、模态、许可证和训练阶段。 现有的数据集搜索系统要么将查询展平为一个嵌入向量（Chen et al., 2023a；Zhang et al., 2025），要么独立地处理各元数据字段（Brickley et al., 2019；Chen et al., 2023b），因此约束违例始终不可见。 把工具交给大语言模型虽然恢复了灵活性，却没有增加任何验证，因此选择数据集的同一个模型也宣称该数据集匹配（Zhang et al., 2024；Jin et al., 2025）。 (2) 证据是异构的。 当数据集卡片写得很好时，文本检索是精确的（Chen et al., 2024b；Zhou et al., 2025），而知识图谱（KG）关系可以找回描述稀疏的资源（Luo et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2025；Lin et al., 2024）。 然而，结构连通性并不蕴含语义契合，因此当没有任何机制抑制图通道引入的噪声时，朴素地添加图通道反而会损害相关性（Luo et al., 2023）。 (3) 检索相关性并不等于训练效用。 标准基准根据分级相关性判断对排序进行评分（Lin et al., 2022；Chen et al., 2024c），但从不衡量所选数据是否能改进下游模型，因此要把搜索质量与以数据为中心的递归自我改进（RSI）——即评估结果驱动训练数据变更的循环（Zou et al., 2026）——联系起来，需要一个能够直接衡量这种变更的协议。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we present AgenticDS , a contract-governed agentic framework for Web dataset acquisition. A Planner compiles the query into a typed search plan of constraints, allowed KG relations, and acceptance criteria. An Engineer executes only admissible deterministic operators over hybrid retrieval, bounded KG expansion, and provenance-preserving pre-ranking. A Critic scores a fixed-format evidence package and either accepts the result or emits a typed diagnosis permitting only local plan repairs. The contracts stop an LLM from silently redefining retrieval semantics during tool use, while the evidence trace keeps text, metadata, content, and KG support separately inspectable.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 AgenticDS，一个由契约治理的面向 Web 数据集获取的智能体框架。 规划器（Planner）将查询编译为包含约束、允许的知识图谱关系以及验收标准的类型化搜索计划。 工程器（Engineer）仅在混合检索、有界知识图谱扩展以及保留溯源的预排序上执行允许的确定性算子。 评审器（Critic）对固定格式的证据包进行评分，要么接受结果，要么发出仅允许局部计划修复的类型化诊断。 这些契约阻止大语言模型在工具使用过程中悄然重定义检索语义，而证据轨迹使文本、元数据、内容和知识图谱支持各自可独立检查。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate this design, we build HuDS-Bench , a KG-grounded benchmark of 200 natural language dataset search queries with 24,908 graded judgments pooled over 15 systems. AgenticDS outranks every system in the pool, and removing the Critic or the Planner costs 0.149 and 0.086 NDCG@10. We then test whether better retrieval translates into better training, feeding each system’s top-5 datasets into corresponding supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of three base models across mathematics, code, and medicine. AgenticDS gives the best downstream accuracy in all three domains, with the largest gain on the weakest base model, supporting the view that external acquisition complements within-corpus data-centric RSI. Ablation then isolates where relational evidence pays: graph expansion whose candidates pass straight into the ranking lowers accuracy on every text backbone, whereas the same expansion behind a provenance-aware Critic improves it, so expansion coupled to verification rather than the graph itself is the mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估该设计，我们构建了 HuDS-Bench，一个以知识图谱为依据的基准，包含 200 条自然语言数据集搜索查询，以及对 15 个系统汇总得到的 24,908 条分级评判。 AgenticDS 在候选系统池中排名超过所有系统，而移除 Critic 或 Planner 会分别损失 0.149 和 0.086 的 NDCG@10。 我们随后检验更好的检索能否转化为更好的训练：将每个系统的前 5 个数据集分别用于三个基础模型在数学、代码和医学领域的监督微调（SFT）。 AgenticDS 在全部三个领域都取得了最佳下游准确率，且在最弱的基础模型上增益最大，这支持了如下观点：外部获取可补充基于语料库内部的数据中心式 RSI。 消融实验进一步定位了关系证据在何处发挥作用：让图扩展的候选直接进入排序会降低所有文本骨干模型上的准确率，而同样的扩展若经过具备溯源意识的 Critic 则能提升准确率，因此其机制在于扩展与验证相耦合，而非图本身。

sents.zh: 消融实验进一步定位了关系证据在何处发挥作用：让图扩展的候选直接进入排序会降低所有文本骨干模型上的准确率，而同样的扩展若经过具备溯源意识的 Critic 则能提升准确率，因此其机制在于扩展与验证相耦合，而非图本身。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 总之，我们的贡献有三个方面：

paragraphs.en: We formulate natural language dataset acquisition on the Web as contract-governed agentic retrieval, and present AgenticDS, whose typed plans, evidence records, and diagnoses separate semantic reasoning from deterministic execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将网络上的自然语言数据集获取问题形式化为由契约约束的智能体检索，并提出 AgenticDS，其类型化计划、证据记录和诊断将语义推理与确定性执行相分离。

paragraphs.en: We show that relational evidence is conditional rather than additive, and contribute the per-candidate provenance representation that lets a verifier turn graph expansion from a liability into a gain.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明关系证据是条件性的而非叠加性的，并提出了逐候选者的来源表示方法，使验证器能够将图扩展从负担转化为收益。

paragraphs.en: We release HuDS-Bench and a search-to-train protocol that measures whether retrieved datasets improve a model, and use them to compare 15 retrieval systems and to fine-tune three base models across mathematics, code, and medicine.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了 HuDS-Bench 以及一个「搜索到训练」（search-to-train）协议，用于衡量检索到的数据集能否改进模型，并利用它们比较了 15 个检索系统，以及在数学、代码和医学领域对三个基础模型进行了微调。

paragraphs.en: Dataset search differs from document retrieval because relevance depends on structured constraints, data content, and intended use beyond text ( Chapman et al., 2020 ) . Beyond Google Dataset Search’s Web metadata index ( Brickley et al., 2019 ) , later work targets dense representations ( Chen et al., 2023a ; Luo et al., 2023 ) , query-focused snippets ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024d ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and integrated public portals ( Chen et al., 2023b ) . Closest to our setting, DataFinder recommends scientific datasets from a natural language description of a research idea ( Viswanathan et al., 2023 ) . It maps one free-text need to a flat bi-encoder ranking over a fixed corpus, without typed constraints, relational evidence, or any check that the recommended data help training. These are the three axes this paper adds . Benchmarks such as ACORDAR evaluate public-data retrieval ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2024c ) but do not model natural language data needs over modern ML hubs. Relational evidence has been explored through general knowledge bases ( Luo et al., 2023 ) and taxonomies of dataset relationships ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . HuggingKG links datasets with models, tasks, papers, spaces, and collections ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . These lines supply the primitives and relational infrastructure AgenticDS composes under a typed contract . We adopt the HuggingKG snapshot as auxiliary infrastructure rather than as a contribution of this paper, using it as one candidate source alongside dense and sparse retrieval, and design HuDS-Bench so that natural language data needs become directly measurable .

paragraphs.en: LLM agents combine planning, tool use, and reflection ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , building on retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) and LLM rankers ( Sun et al., 2023 ) . Zhang et al. ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) formalize “agentic information retrieval” as agents that plan, execute, and refine multi-step search strategies. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) learns when to call a search engine during reasoning, and Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025b ) embeds agentic Web search into extended reasoning chains. A study of 14 million real queries shows that agentic intents and trajectories differ markedly from traditional Web search ( Ning et al., 2026 ) . Most such systems target open-domain question answering and give the LLM direct control of tools, which entangles query interpretation with index operations and makes errors and reruns hard to compare. Commercial coding agents prompted to search Hugging Face behave the same way. AgenticDS instead keeps semantic reasoning inside typed contracts and leaves indexing, traversal, filtering, and scoring deterministic , trading open-ended tool flexibility for reproducibility, provenance-transparent ranking, and bounded token cost.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体结合了规划、工具使用与反思（Yao et al., 2023），并建立在检索增强生成（Lewis et al., 2020）和LLM排序器（Sun et al., 2023）的基础之上。Zhang et al. （Zhang et al., 2024）将“智能体化信息检索”形式化为能够规划、执行并改进多步搜索策略的智能体。 Search-R1（Jin et al., 2025）学习在推理过程中何时调用搜索引擎，而Search-o1（Li et al., 2025b）将智能体化网络搜索嵌入到扩展的推理链中。 一项针对1400万条真实查询的研究表明，智能体化的意图与轨迹同传统网络搜索存在显著差异（Ning et al., 2026）。 这类系统大多面向开放域问答，让LLM直接控制工具，这使得查询解释与索引操作纠缠在一起，导致错误与重跑难以比较。 被提示去搜索Hugging Face的商业编码智能体也表现出同样的行为。 相反，AgenticDS将语义推理保留在类型化契约之内，而将索引、遍历、过滤与评分保持为确定性操作，以牺牲开放式工具的灵活性为代价，换取可复现性、来源透明的排序以及有界的token开销。

paragraphs.en: Data-centric RSI systems filter, select, rewrite, or synthesize samples from a known corpus. DataEvolver learns preparation pipelines from raw data and seeds through operator- and pipeline-level feedback ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . DataFoundry evolves a data-construction runtime and synthesizes instruction–response pairs from supplied documents ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . The broader literature studies evaluation-driven updates to data, retrieval state, memory, or policies ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2024e ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . All presuppose a corpus already in hand and optimize data within it, while our work targets the preceding step . We acquire external datasets from an open Web ecosystem given a user query, and verify utility through controlled fine-tuning. That search-to-train primitive is the ingredient these systems assume, positioning AgenticDS as a complementary upstream component of future data-centric loops rather than a competing in-corpus optimizer.
paragraphs.zh: 以数据为中心的 RSI 系统对已知语料库中的样本进行过滤、选择、重写或合成。 DataEvolver 通过算子级和管线级反馈，从原始数据和种子中学习数据准备管线（Deng 等，2026）。 DataFoundry 演化数据构建运行时，并从提供的文档中合成指令–回答对（Yang 等，2026）。 更广泛的文献研究了针对数据、检索状态、记忆或策略的评估驱动更新（Zou 等，2026；Chen 等，2024e；Yuan 等，2024；Wang 等，2025）。 这些工作都预设手头已有语料库，并在其中优化数据，而我们的工作则针对其前一步骤。 我们在给定用户查询的情况下，从开放的 Web 生态中获取外部数据集，并通过受控微调来验证其效用。 这种“搜索到训练”的原子能力正是这些系统所假设的前提，这使得 AgenticDS 成为未来以数据为中心的闭环的互补性上游组件，而非语料库内优化器的竞争者。

paragraphs.en: AgenticDS follows three principles. Contracts before actions makes typed plans delimit the admissible operators. Provenance before fusion keeps evidence sources separately inspectable. Bounded autonomy lets budgets and diagnoses constrain search and local plan repairs. These principles bound what the LLM may redefine without discarding the semantic flexibility needed to interpret complex queries. Figure 1 gives an overview of the pipeline, and Algorithm 1 formalizes the search loop.

paragraphs.en: HuDS-Bench targets realistic Web dataset search over HuggingFace and consists of 200 English queries of four types, two semantic (general and fine-tuning) and two relational (paper-reference and entity-neighbor). Its construction is KG-grounded. An extractor derives structured conditions from a gold dataset’s metadata and, for relational types, from HuggingKG ( Chen et al., 2025 ) anchors. An LLM, GLM-5.2, writes a concise user need from a controlled subset of those conditions, seeing the anchor and target relation but not the gold dataset’s identity or card text for the two relational types. Rule-based checks and manual verification then reject queries that expose the gold dataset’s HuggingFace identifier, copy long card spans, omit intent, or collapse to an exact-name lookup.
paragraphs.zh: HuDS-Bench 面向基于 HuggingFace 的真实 Web 数据集搜索，由 200 条英文查询组成，共四种类型：两种语义型（通用型和微调型）和两种关系型（论文引用型和实体邻接型）。 其构建过程以知识图谱为基础。 抽取器从金标数据集的元数据中导出结构化条件，对于关系型类型，则从 HuggingKG（Chen et al., 2025）的锚点中导出。 一个大语言模型 GLM-5.2 从这些条件的一个受控子集出发撰写一条简洁的用户需求，对于两种关系型类型，它可以看到锚点和目标关系，但看不到金标数据集的身份信息或数据集卡片文本。 随后通过基于规则的检查和人工验证，拒绝那些泄露金标数据集 HuggingFace 标识、复制长段卡片文本、缺少意图描述、或退化为精确名称查找的查询。

paragraphs.en: Candidate pools merge the top-20 results of all 15 evaluated systems, with the gold dataset injected only when no system retrieves it. The pool holds 24,908 query–candidate pairs. Rather than pass raw dataset cards to an annotator, we compile each query into a structured rubric and assemble a per-candidate evidence package, from which the LLM annotator, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, resolves each constraint to a three-valued status that we deterministically project to a graded 0/1/2 label for the candidate. A second, independent pass by the same model re-checks every disputed item, and residual disagreements go to human adjudication. Against a 2,490-pair human-annotated sample the pipeline reaches linearly weighted Cohen’s κ = 0.754 \kappa=0.754 , substantial agreement on the conventional scale ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) . Appendix C gives the rubric, the label distribution by query type, and the annotation procedure.

paragraphs.en: We instantiate the protocol with three base models (Qwen2.5-7B ( Qwen Team et al., 2024 ) , Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , and Olmo-3-7B-Instruct ( Team Olmo et al., 2025 ) ), across three domains (mathematics, code, and medicine) with one realistic query per domain. Learning rate and epoch are selected on a held-out development split, never on the evaluation benchmarks, and we report the test score of the checkpoint that development selection picked. Scores are calculated for a grid of three base models and eight benchmarks: {GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021b ) , AMC23, OCWCourses ( Lewkowycz et al., 2022 ) } for math, {HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , BigCodeBench ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) } for code, and {MedQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) , MMLU-Medical ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) } for medicine, then averaged across base models. The same split, selection procedure, and grid apply to every method, so none is given more selection freedom than another. For statistical significance we block by (domain, base model) and enumerate all 2 9 2^{9} sign flips of the nine block differences, Holm-correcting the comparison of AgenticDS with four strong baselines (Section 4.3 ). Because those blocks share three training corpora and the study has no independent training seeds, we read these tests as a consistency check across blocks rather than as a measure of how much retraining would move the scores.

paragraphs.en: Where does agentic search win most? The gain is mechanism-aligned rather than uniform: over the hybrid baseline AgenticDS gains + + 0.075 and + + 0.105 NDCG@10 on general and fine-tuning queries, but + + 0.206 and + + 0.197 on paper-reference and entity-neighbor queries, so the advantage roughly doubles once an answer stops being recoverable from card text alone. All four gains survive Holm correction over the 56 per-type comparisons (Appendix D ). Against the two agent baselines, however, gains separate only on general and fine-tuning queries. On the 40 paper-reference and 30 entity-neighbor queries the differences do not reach the threshold, which we read as insufficient power on those subsets rather than as equivalence. One query makes the mechanism concrete. Asked for “datasets used to train or finetune the PicoLM-0.5M model”, text retrieval returns benchmarks that merely share the model’s name, whereas the Planner makes the training-source relation a hard constraint and the Engineer reaches three supported corpora whose cards never mention the model at all. The gain therefore tracks the mechanism that produces it, widening where an answer has to be reached through a relation , which is the case the typed anchor constraint and the whitelisted traversal were designed for.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式检索在哪里优势最大？ 增益与机制对齐而非均匀分布：相对于混合基线，AgenticDS 在通用查询和微调查询上分别获得 + + 0.075 和 + + 0.105 的 NDCG@10 提升，而在论文引用查询和实体邻居查询上分别获得 + + 0.206 和 + + 0.197 的提升，因此一旦答案无法仅凭卡片文本恢复，优势大约会翻倍。 全部四项增益在 56 项按类型比较中经 Holm 校正后依然显著（附录 D）。 然而与两个智能体基线相比，增益仅在通用查询和微调查询上分离显著。 在 40 个论文引用查询和 30 个实体邻居查询上，差异未达到阈值，我们将其解读为在这些子集上统计功效不足，而非等同于无差异。 一个查询使该机制变得具体。 当被问及“用于训练或微调 PicoLM-0.5M 模型的数据集”时，文本检索返回的基准数据集只是恰好与该模型同名，而规划器将训练来源关系作为硬约束，工程师则找到了三个有依据支持的语料库，其卡片中从未提及该模型。 因此增益与产生它的机制相伴随，在需要通过关系才能得到答案的地方扩大，而这正是类型化锚点约束和白名单遍历所针对设计的场景。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 ablates the AgenticDS search pipeline on HuDS-Bench over ten configurations. This is our primary ablation: it is measured on all 200 queries, every configuration loses accuracy relative to the full system, and the three largest losses all involve the Critic. The Critic and the Planner dominate ( − - 0.149 and − - 0.086 NDCG@10), KG expansion follows at − - 0.084, and the remaining three components fall between − - 0.017 and − - 0.036. The feedback-loop entry removes replanning entirely, stopping after the first round, so its − - 0.036 measures what the whole revision mechanism buys. The adaptive budget is the Engineer’s per-branch allocation of the anchor, neighbor, and pool budgets, replaced here by an equal split, and sample evidence is the sample fields in the Critic’s evidence package, withheld here. paragraphs.en: Table 3 answers whether retrieval gains transfer to model gains. AgenticDS leads the other four acquisition methods in all three domains, with a grand mean of 52.81 against 49.75 for the second-best, a + + 3.06 margin. Margins in this subsection are means of the three domain averages, each of which first averages the three base models. The equal-weight 24-block mean gives the same ordering. The advantage over each of the four methods is statistically significant after Holm correction ( p = 0.016 p=0.016 to 0.020 0.020 ), with AgenticDS ahead in 7 of the nine (domain, base model) blocks against Claude Code, 8 against the hybrid of Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and BM25, and all nine against Codex and monoT5-based reranking. paragraphs.en: Does the search-end ablation survive fine-tuning? Table 4 repeats each single-module ablation through the search-to-train protocol, aggregated over all nine (domain, base model) blocks. It does not resolve the question for any individual component. paragraphs.en: Figure 3 compares AgenticDS with the two agent baselines over the 200 queries, with AgenticDS running under its full T = 3 T=3 cap. AgenticDS matches Claude Code’s wall-clock time (150.5 vs. 139.3 seconds per query) while billing 12.3M tokens against 111.4M and 280.9M. Most of that token gap is cached prompt reuse billed at a lower rate, so AgenticDS’s relative cost savings are smaller than its relative token savings. Because all three systems run the same GLM-5.2 backbone, one price list settles the comparison: the 200-query evaluation costs $19.86 for AgenticDS against $48.78 and $112.40, savings of 59% and 82%, and AgenticDS is 5.8 × 5.8\times faster than Codex end to end. The saving is a lower bound, since AgenticDS has no cache-hit breakdown and is billed entirely at the uncached input rate. The architectural reason is that the Engineer reads each dataset card at most once and the Critic receives a fixed-format evidence package, whereas free-form tool-calling agents re-fetch and re-read cards during open-ended exploration.

paragraphs.en: Within AgenticDS the two costs sit in different places. The Critic accounts for 83.0% of the tokens but only 28% of the wall clock, the two Planner calls take half the wall clock on 13% of the tokens, and the retrieval and fusion stage is deterministic and spends no tokens at all. Appendix G gives the token totals, the per-system costs, and the price list behind these figures. Bounded autonomy therefore has a measurable payoff. Even with three rounds available, fixing the operator vocabulary and capping the budget holds cost near-constant per query, whereas an open-ended agent’s cost grows with however long it chooses to explore.

paragraphs.en: From retrieval to acquisition. AgenticDS makes dataset search behave more like product search or paper discovery. It interprets a natural language intent, orchestrates structured and unstructured evidence, and returns candidates that serve the operational purpose of training rather than merely matching a description. paragraphs.en: The role of KG evidence. HuggingKG is infrastructure rather than a contribution, and it does two jobs. During search, bounded paths supplement lexical retrieval and record why a resource was reached. During benchmark construction, relation-grounded queries create needs that copying card text cannot meet. The boundary condition on the first job is sharp. Graph candidates added without semantic verification lower NDCG@10 by 0.025–0.029 across three backbones, so expansion and verification are not separable features. Where the graph does pay, it pays as designed: entity-neighbor queries needing one- or two-hop traversal gain + + 0.197 NDCG@10, against + + 0.075 for general queries already answerable from card text. Appendix H traces both behaviours on individual queries, including one the system correctly reports as unsatisfiable.

paragraphs.en: In this paper we presented AgenticDS, a contract-governed agentic framework for natural language instructed dataset acquisition on the Web, in which a Planner, an Engineer, and a Critic exchange typed plans, evidence records, and diagnoses so that semantic reasoning never silently rewrites what the retrieval stack does. Experiments on HuDS-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 queries and 24,908 graded judgments pooled over 15 systems, show consistent improvements over both commercial LLM agents and strong dense–sparse retrieval pipelines, and a controlled search-to-train study confirms that the datasets AgenticDS returns yield the best downstream accuracy in all three domains we study. Further analysis shows that relational evidence is conditional rather than additive, since graph expansion pays off only once a provenance-aware verifier checks the path behind each candidate. Dataset acquisition can therefore be treated as an upstream stage of a data-centric improvement loop whose quality is judged by the model it trains rather than by relevance alone.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 AgenticDS，一个由契约治理的智能体框架，用于在网络上通过自然语言指令进行数据集获取；其中规划者、工程师和批评者交换类型化的计划、证据记录和诊断，从而使语义推理永远不会在暗中改写检索栈的实际行为。 在 HuDS-Bench 上的实验表明，该新基准包含 200 个查询以及汇总自 15 个系统的 24,908 条分级判断，结果显示我们相较商业大语言模型智能体和强密集—稀疏检索流水线均取得了一致的改进；并且一项从搜索到训练的对照研究证实，AgenticDS 返回的数据集在我们研究的全部三个领域中都能带来最佳的下游准确率。 进一步的分析表明，关系型证据是有条件的而非可累加的，因为只有在具备来源感知能力的验证器检查了每个候选背后的路径之后，图扩展才会带来收益。 因此，数据集获取可以被当作以数据为中心的改进循环的上游阶段，其质量由它所训练出的模型来评判，而非仅凭相关性来判断。

paragraphs.en: The construction pipeline derives structured conditions (task, modality, language, scale, format) from each gold dataset’s textual metadata and KG neighborhood, generates a need-centric query, and verifies that the result does not leak the repository identifier or collapse to a single lookup. Candidate pools merge the top-20 results of all 15 evaluated systems. Each candidate’s evidence package contains concise card excerpts, normalized metadata, sample fields and instruction–response snippets when available, and retrieval and graph provenance. Using a structured rubric (released with the code), the LLM annotator marks every constraint satisfied , violated , or unknown and cites an evidence code for each satisfied or violated decision, which we deterministically project to a graded label. Label 2 requires an exact or strong intent match with satisfied hard constraints, a matched dataset role, and direct evidence, label 1 covers partial matches, and label 0 marks hard conflicts or role mismatches. A verifier model re-checks any item with an evidence conflict, a role mismatch, an unknown on a hard constraint, or an unresolved relation, and disputes are escalated to human review. Table 6 gives the distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 构建流水线从每个黄金数据集的文本元数据和知识图谱邻域中提取结构化条件（任务、模态、语言、规模、格式），生成以需求为中心的查询，并验证结果不会泄露仓库标识符或退化为单次查找。 候选池合并了所有 15 个被评估系统的前 20 个结果。 每个候选的证据包包含简洁的数据集卡片摘录、规范化元数据、可用时的样本字段和指令–回复片段，以及检索与图谱溯源信息。 借助结构化评分表（随代码一同发布），大语言模型标注器将每条约束标记为满足、违反或未知，并为每个满足或违反的判定引用证据编号，我们将其确定性地投影为分级标签。 标签 2 要求与硬约束满足情况的意图精确或高度匹配、数据集角色匹配以及直接证据；标签 1 覆盖部分匹配；标签 0 标记硬冲突或角色不匹配。 验证模型会复查任何存在证据冲突、角色不匹配、硬约束未知或关系未解决的项目，有争议的项目会升级至人工审核。 表 6 给出了分布情况。

paragraphs.en: To check that the automated pipeline reproduces human judgment rather than being self-consistent, we drew 2,490 distinct query–dataset pairs (10.0% of the 24,908 judged pairs) by random sampling without replacement, spanning 1,051 general, 534 fine-tuning, 490 paper-reference, and 415 entity-neighbor pairs, including 861 flagged for review, which were not excluded. One researcher familiar with machine-learning datasets independently applied the same 0/1/2 label criteria, seeing the query, metadata, full dataset card, and the necessary entity-page and graph evidence. Because partial credit is the hardest grade to assign, label 1 is also the grade on which the two relational query types almost never fire (Table 6 ), so the overall agreement score mainly reflects the two semantic types. Comparing the annotator’s first labels with the previously frozen automated labels, before any disagreement analysis or correction, yields 84.1% exact agreement (2,095/2,490) and linearly weighted Cohen’s κ = 0.754 \kappa=0.754 , substantial agreement ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) .

paragraphs.en: Table 8 also bounds the architecture’s claim. It varies only the agent backbone, holding the retrieval stack and all contracts fixed. The contracts constrain what the Planner and Critic may emit, not how well they reason: with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B the system still clears every retrieval baseline (0.5244 NDCG@10), but with GLM-4-9B it falls to 0.4706, level with BM25 (0.4717) and below the hybrid baseline (0.4893). The contract-governed loop therefore converts backbone capability into ranking quality without substituting for it, and a frontier-scale Critic is a prerequisite, not an optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 表8还对该架构的声明范围进行了限定。 它仅改变智能体骨干模型，而保持检索组件栈与所有契约不变。 这些契约约束的是规划器与评审器可以输出什么，而非它们的推理能力有多强：使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 时，系统仍能超过所有检索基线（0.5244 NDCG@10）；但使用 GLM-4-9B 时，性能降至 0.4706，与 BM25（0.4717）持平，并低于混合基线（0.4893）。 因此，契约治理的循环能够将骨干模型的能力转化为排序质量，但无法替代这种能力；一个前沿规模的评审器是前提条件，而非一种优化手段。

paragraphs.en: Two cases show how contracts organize evidence. (1) For the fine-tuning query “ instruction tuning data with code commit messages as natural language instructions across programming languages ”, the Planner separates code generation, supervision format, and commit provenance into complementary hypotheses. The Engineer’s dense branch returns four commit-oriented corpora in the top-10, two of which the Critic rejects because their sample fields show synthetic rather than real-commit prompts, and those rejections guide a local repair hypothesis. (2) For the general query “ large Hungarian-only medical consultation data ”, none of the top five results is relevant. The Critic diagnoses unmet language and domain requirements, and local repair must preserve the Hungarian-only constraint, which broader Finno-Ugric or English candidates cannot satisfy. Reporting an unresolvable constraint is the correct behavior here, and separates AgenticDS from both commercial agent baselines, which silently returned near-miss English or Spanish corpora.
paragraphs.zh: 两个案例展示了合约如何组织证据。 (1) 对于微调查询「以代码提交信息作为跨编程语言自然语言指令的指令微调数据」，Planner 将代码生成、监督格式与提交来源拆分为互补假设。 Engineer 的稠密分支在前 10 名中返回四个面向提交的语料库，其中两个被 Critic 否决，因为其样本字段显示的是合成提示而非真实提交提示，而这些否决引导出局部修复假设。 (2) 对于通用查询「仅匈牙利语的大规模医疗咨询数据」，前五个结果均不相关。 Critic 诊断出未满足的语言与领域需求，且局部修复必须保留仅匈牙利语的约束，这是更宽泛的芬兰-乌戈尔语或英语候选所无法满足的。 报告无法解决的约束在此是正确的行为，这也将 AgenticDS 与那些默默返回近乎命中的英语或西班牙语语料库的商业智能体基线区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. (1) The two relational query types are built from HuggingKG anchors that the Engineer can also traverse. The design bounds what that overlap can buy: 130 of the 200 queries carry no KG-derived gold label, every non-KG baseline is given HuggingFace’s full-text search, and the variant without KG expansion still reaches 0.5307 NDCG@10, above every non-agent baseline. Extending construction to KG-free gold labels would remove the overlap entirely. (2) With one query per domain across three base models, the utility study is powered to separate acquisition methods in aggregate rather than individual components. Its scope is English queries on a single ML hub, at a latency suited to offline acquisition rather than interactive search. (3) The agreement study reports a single κ \kappa over all four query types. Because the relational types rarely use the middle grade, that figure speaks mainly for the semantic types, and per-type coefficients would be more informative.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 (1) 两种关系型查询由 HuggingKG 锚点构建，而工程师也可以遍历这些锚点。 该设计限定了这种重叠所能带来的收益：200 个查询中有 130 个不携带来自知识图谱的金标准标签，每个非知识图谱基线都被赋予 HuggingFace 的全文搜索，且不使用知识图谱扩展的变体仍达到 0.5307 的 NDCG@10，高于所有非智能体基线。 若将构建扩展到不依赖知识图谱的金标准标签，则可完全消除这种重叠。 (2) 由于每个领域仅针对三个基础模型各使用一个查询，效用研究的统计功效只能从总体上区分各类获取方法，而非区分各个组件。 其范围是单一机器学习平台上的英文查询，其延迟适合离线获取而非交互式搜索。 (3) 一致性研究在全部四种查询类型上仅报告一个 κ \kappa 值。 由于关系型查询很少使用中间等级，该数值主要反映语义型查询的情况，而按类型分别计算的系数将更具参考价值。

paragraphs.en: Future work. Four directions follow. Sharpening the search-to-train protocol calls for more queries per domain and repeated seeds rather than more benchmarks. A gold-label pipeline that never consults the graph would settle the overlap above. Distilling the Critic into a smaller pairwise scorer attacks the dominant cost. Finally, only the Engineer is tied to a hub, so any ecosystem with typed metadata and a navigable relation graph could be served by swapping it. A federation layer routing typed constraints to several hubs would test the contracts outside HuggingFace.
paragraphs.zh: 未来工作。有四个方向。 改进搜索到训练的流程，需要在每个领域上进行更多查询并使用重复的随机种子，而不是增加更多基准。 一条从不查询图谱的黄金标签流水线可以解决上述重叠问题。 将 Critic 蒸馏为更小的成对评分器可以攻克主要成本。 最后，只有 Engineer 与某个 hub 绑定，因此任何拥有类型化元数据和可导航关系图谱的生态系统，都可以通过替换它来获得服务。 一个将类型化约束路由到多个 hub 的联邦层，可以在 HuggingFace 之外检验这些契约。
